exam_scheme.note: Under Gujarat Police PSI Recruitment Board directives, selection comprises: Stage 1 Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST), Stage 2 Preliminary Written Examination (100 marks, 2 hours), Stage 3 Mains Written Examination (4 papers, 400 marks total), and Stage 4 Document Verification & Medical Examination. Negative marking in objective tests is 0.25 marks per wrong answer.

stages.stage_name: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST)
stages.source_label: Gujarat Police PSI Recruitment Board PET/PST Directives

papers.paper_name: Endurance Run (Male: 5,000m in max 25 mins; Female: 1,600m in max 9m 30s; Ex-Servicemen: 2,400m in max 12m 30s) & Physical Measurements
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying physical standards (Height: Male 164 cm [SC/ST 162 cm], Female 158 cm [SC/ST 156 cm]; Chest: Male 79-84 cm)

stages.source_label: Gujarat Police PSI Preliminary Examination Pattern & Scheme

papers.paper_name: General Studies & Mental Ability (GK, Current Affairs, History, Geography, Science, Psychology, Sociology, Reasoning)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer (Option E = Not Attempted avoids penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit ranking for shortlisting to Mains (up to 15 times the category-wise vacancies)

stages.source_label: Gujarat Police PSI Mains Examination Syllabus & Structure

papers.paper_name: Paper 1 — Gujarati Language (Grammar, Comprehension, Essay, Vocabulary)
Paper 2 — English Language (Grammar, Translation, Comprehension, Précis)
Paper 3 — General Studies (History, Geography, Polity, Science, Tech, Current Affairs)
Paper 4 — Legal Aspects & Criminal Law (Constitution of India, IPC/BNS, CrPC/BNSS, Indian Evidence Act/BSA, Gujarat Police Act, Prohibition Act, SC/ST PoA Act)

stages.stage_name: Document Verification and Medical Fitness Examination
stages.source_label: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board Verification & Medical Directives

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Academic Degrees, Age Proof, Domicile Certificate, Category Proof & Medical Board Examination
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in medical fitness standards and document scrutiny

financial_package.note: Under Gujarat Civil Services rules, direct Class-3 appointees serve on a 5-year fixed pay contract (Fix Pay System) at ₹38,090 per month. Upon successful completion of the 5-year probation, officers are absorbed into regular Pay Matrix Level 7 (₹39,900–₹1,26,600 with Entry Basic Pay ₹39,900) under the Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules Schedule Level 7
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹39,900 at 58% DA (₹23,142 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (10% to 24%: ₹3,990 to ₹9,576 for Ahmedabad/Surat X-category and other posting districts), Police Uniform Maintenance Allowance, Investigation Allowance, net of NPS (10% of Basic+DA = ₹6,304) and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Gujarat Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (Class X, Y, and Z cities)
Police uniform maintenance grant, holster and ammunition allowance, and kit upkeep
Investigation allowance, mobile phone reimbursement, and travel allowances on duty
Government accommodation entitlement or police executive quarters
Comprehensive medical coverage under Gujarat State Employees Health Scheme
